title: Stop paying twice for rejected anodized parts
audience: Procurement and quality managers buying anodized aluminum parts (website, LinkedIn, sales follow-up email)

scenes.text: Every rejected lot of anodized parts costs you twice: once in rework, and again in missed ship dates.

visual.headline: Stop paying twice for rejected anodized parts

scenes.text: Most rejects trace back to three specs nobody wrote on the drawing: coating class, seal test, and color tolerance.

scenes.text: So we review every drawing before production, and lock those three specs with you in writing.
